distribution: Distinct integer coordinates uniformly sampled from [0,999]^2
labels: Exact optimal closed tours, canonical start 0 and lexicographically smaller reversal
distance: Unrounded Euclidean; neighbor hints rounded to 1 decimal; displayed objective to 3 decimals
deduplication: Hash of sorted coordinate pairs; shared exclusion set across train/validation per size
prompt: Instruction + input with two nearest-neighbor hints; native LLaDA user/assistant chat template at tokenization
source: Adapted format; not an exact replication of LLMCoSolver training
